items.title_en: Russian Satellite Stalks U.S. Radar Craft Aiding Ukraine
items.title_zh: 俄卫星近距离跟踪为乌克兰提供雷达情报的美方相关卫星
items.hook_en: A Russian military satellite crept within kilometers of a U.S.-owned radar satellite that helps Ukraine's forces with imaging intel, then backed off after days of close tracking.
items.hook_zh: 俄军用卫星逼近帮助乌军成像的美属雷达卫星数公里内，近距跟踪数日后撤离。
items.summary_en: Kosmos-2612, launched in April 2026, spent weeks adjusting its orbit to approach ICEYE-X36, a Finnish-American satellite providing all-weather radar images to Ukraine. Public data showed it closing to within a few kilometers by mid-October, station-keeping nearby for two days in what analysts called the first unapproved rendezvous of active low-Earth orbit satellites. LeoLabs tracked it as close as 500 meters at times, allowing potential reconnaissance from multiple angles, though ICEYE confirmed no damage and Russia offered no comment. The satellite pulled away on October 18, highlighting rising tensions where commercial space assets support military efforts.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 4 月发射的「宇宙-2612」数周调整轨道接近 ICEYE-X36（芬美合作、向乌提供全天候雷达图）。公开数据显示 10 月中逼近数公里内并驻留约两天，分析称系在轨活跃卫星首次未经批准交会。LeoLabs 曾测得近至约 500 米；ICEYE 确认无损坏，俄方未置评。该星 10 月 18 日离开，凸显商用太空资产支援军事时的紧张。

items.title_en: Japan Launches MMX Spacecraft to Collect First Samples from Mars Moon
items.title_zh: 日本发射 MMX：将首次从火星卫星取样返回
items.hook_en: At dawn from Tanegashima Space Center, Japan's H3 rocket roared to life, carrying the MMX probe toward Mars' mysterious moon Phobos.
items.hook_zh: 黎明时分种子岛 H3 火箭升空，搭载 MMX 奔向神秘的火卫一。
items.summary_en: The launch happened at 4:41 a.m. local time on October 20, with JAXA confirming the spacecraft's successful separation into orbit just over an hour later. MMX will arrive at the Mars system in August 2027, study Phobos and Deimos, deploy a French-German rover named IDEFIX, and return at least 10 grams of Phobos samples to Earth in 2031 to uncover clues about the moons' origins. This first interplanetary flight for the H3 rocket includes NASA instruments and marks Japan's biggest international planetary mission, testing tech for future Mars exploration.
items.summary_zh: 发射于当地时间 10 月 20 日 4:41，JAXA 约一小时后确认入轨分离成功。MMX 预计 2027 年 8 月抵达火星系统，研究火卫一与火卫二，部署法德巡视器 IDEFIX，并在 2031 年将至少 10 克火卫一样品送回地球，探寻卫星起源。此为 H3 首次星际飞行，含 NASA 仪器，是日本最大国际行星任务，亦为未来火星探测试技术。
items.body_en:
At dawn from Tanegashima Space Center, Japan's H3 rocket roared to life, carrying the MMX probe toward Mars' mysterious moon Phobos.

The launch happened at 4:41 a.m. local time on October 20, with JAXA confirming the spacecraft's successful separation into orbit just over an hour later.

MMX will arrive at the Mars system in August 2027, study Phobos and Deimos, deploy a French-German rover named IDEFIX, and return at least 10 grams of Phobos samples to Earth in 2031 to uncover clues about the moons' origins. This first interplanetary flight for the H3 rocket includes NASA instruments and marks Japan's biggest international planetary mission, testing tech for future Mars exploration.
items.body_zh:

发射于当地时间 10 月 20 日 4:41，JAXA 约一小时后确认入轨分离成功。MMX 预计 2027 年 8 月抵达火星系统，研究火卫一与火卫二，部署法德巡视器 IDEFIX，并在 2031 年将至少 10 克火卫一样品送回地球，探寻卫星起源。

此为 H3 首次星际飞行，含 NASA 仪器，是日本最大国际行星任务，亦为未来火星探测试技术。

items.title_en: Rocket Lab Videos Automated Machine Building Neutron Rocket Dome
items.title_zh: 火箭实验室晒自动铺丝机制作 Neutron 整流罩穹顶
items.hook_en: Thousands of hair-thin carbon fibers whip into place at blistering speeds, forming the massive forward dome for Neutron's Stage 1 tank. It's a glimpse into the precision powering Rocket Lab's next big leap.
items.hook_zh: 成千上万根发丝般碳纤维高速铺就 Neutron 一级贮箱巨大前穹顶。
items.summary_en: Rocket Lab released footage of its automated fiber placement machine at the Maryland facility laying down carbon strands up to 100 meters per minute on custom molds for the Neutron rocket's large composite forward dome. This step follows last week's news of a 2027 first-launch target after fixing voids in a prior manual dome, with CEO Peter Beck confirming refined processes and a successful aft dome. Investors and fans praised the update for building excitement around production progress toward a reusable rocket carrying 13,000 kg to orbit, with upcoming tests ahead.

items.title_en: Disc Medicine's Bitopertin Succeeds in Key Trial for Rare Sunlight Disorder
items.title_zh: Disc Medicine 口服药 bitopertin 关键试验成功，针对罕见日光症
items.hook_en: For people with erythropoietic protoporphyria, a rare condition that makes sunlight agonizing, an oral pill just showed it can cut toxic buildup and add hours of pain-free time outdoors each month.
items.hook_zh: 红细胞生成性原卟啉症患者见光剧痛；口服药显示可降毒素堆积、每月多出无痛户外时间。
items.summary_en: Disc Medicine announced strong Phase 3 results for bitopertin, which met both primary endpoints and all secondary goals in patients with EPP and X-linked protoporphyria. The drug reduced protoporphyrin IX by 41.4% more than placebo and gave patients 12.2 extra hours of pain-free light exposure monthly, plus fewer painful reactions and better quality of life. Well-tolerated with mostly mild dizziness, the company plans an FDA resubmission by late 2026, backed by $718 million in cash. The news sent shares up nearly 35%, offering hope for an easier treatment than implants.
items.summary_zh: Disc Medicine 公布 bitopertin 三期强劲结果：在 EPP 与 X 连锁原卟啉症患者中达成双主要终点及全部次要终点。相对安慰剂，原卟啉 IX 多降 41.4%，每月无痛光照多 12.2 小时，疼痛反应减少、生活质量改善。耐受性良好，多为轻度头晕；公司拟 2026 年底前提交 FDA，现金约 7.18 亿美元。消息推动股价涨近 35%，有望比植入疗法更便捷。
